a.lede: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
a.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’

b.lede: The U.S. Army is developing a program to deploy autonomous AI agents that can navigate digital and network infrastructures, identify targets, and “neutralize” them.
b.title: U.S. Army developing program that would deploy AI agents to autonomously seek and destroy targets in enemy digital infrastructures
